title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality recording captures a high‑energy show with standout China Cat > Rider, To Lay Me Down and the tear‑jerking Sailor→Saint sequence.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its vibrant second set, highlighted by a scorching China Cat > Rider stretch, an inspiring To Lay Me Down, and the emotionally powerful Sailor→Saint pairing. Brent Mydland’s frenzied organ work and distinctive vocals are noted as adding fresh color to the performance. No recording issues are reported, suggesting a clean capture.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are positive (4‑5 stars) and emphasize strong musical moments; no technical complaints imply at least good recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers do not mention any sound problems, indicating the audio is clear enough for enjoyment despite the source being unspecified.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set builds momentum to a hot China>Rider, while the second set is described as especially fine and fire‑stoked by To Lay Me Down.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s grainy voice and frenzied organ playing are highlighted as enlivening the band's new sound.
band_member_comments.Drums: A post‑drums sequence is singled out as a highlight, indicating strong rhythmic moments.
